turnaround_reason: SRPT collapsed in 2025 after patient deaths and a boxed liver-injury warning on ELEVIDYS (its DMD gene therapy), an FDA shipping pause, and removal of the non-ambulatory indication — revenue fell 34% YoY. The stock is now recovering after the FDA reversed the shipping pause, management removed the near-term debt overhang via a 2027->2030 convert exchange, and insiders bought aggressively.
bullish_points: FDA reversed the ELEVIDYS shipping pause; management guides to gradual momentum returning in 2H26 into 2027
Very heavy insider buying: 11 purchases / ~907k shares, net +900k shares in last 6 months — strong conviction signal
Short interest is ~31% of float with an 8.66 short ratio — meaningful squeeze fuel on any good news
PMO (exon-skipping) franchise still generating ~$230M/quarter — real, cash-generative base business beneath the ELEVIDYS story
Debt overhang pushed out to 2030 via convert exchange; $788M cash on hand
Cohort 8 of ENDEAVOR (sirolimus pretreatment) aims to restore non-ambulatory access — a potential label re-expansion catalyst
bearish_points: ELEVIDYS carries a boxed warning for serious liver injury tied to patient deaths — an overhang that caps prescriber confidence
Revenue growth -34% and gross margins negative (-17%) on the trailing window; the recovery is a hope, not yet a trend
Stock already ran +44% in 30 days / +17% in 5 days — much of the near-term good news may be priced
Gene-therapy safety headlines are binary and can re-break the thesis at any time
catalyst: Sequential ELEVIDYS revenue re-acceleration in 2H26 earnings prints, plus ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 data supporting a path back to the non-ambulatory population
catalyst_timing: 2H 2026 quarterly prints (Q3 2026 report) and ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 readouts over the next several quarters
suggested_trade: Small-to-medium starter spot near $22-23; scale on a confirmed revenue re-acceleration print rather than chasing the run
key_risk: A new ELEVIDYS safety event (further liver-injury deaths) that triggers another pause or label restriction and re-breaks the recovery
would_skip_if: You need confirmation the ELEVIDYS rebuild is real — skip until at least one quarter shows sequential ELEVIDYS revenue growth; also skip if chasing after the +44% 30-day move rather than buying a pullback
